title: Do Hallucination Detectors Read the Context? Transfer, Adaptation, and Grounding in Bengali Retrieval-Augmented Generation
description:
Companion repository of the paper submitted to ACM TALLIP. It contains the notebooks, frozen thresholds, per-example predictions (hashed ids and scores, no dataset text), original-run and post hoc result tables and figures, and the error-analysis annotation files behind every number in the paper.

Licences: code under MIT (LICENSE); research outputs (predictions, results, annotation data, documentation) under CC BY 4.0 (LICENSE-DATA.md); the manuscript in paper/ is not licensed. No dataset is redistributed.
